tools.name: list_catalog
tools.description: List all 9 albums and 27 wellness music tracks with prices ($5.99/track, $14.99/album) and per-track session evidence. No payment required.

tools.name: get_track_evidence
tools.description: Get the History session evidence for one track: session count, mean/median/min/max RMSSD (ms), mean heart rate (bpm), and the underlying sessions. Tracks with no sessions report session_count 0. Wellness music; not a medical device; rPPG-derived HRV values are estimates.

tools.name: purchase_track
tools.description: Purchase a single track ($5.99 USDC via x402 v2 or v1). Returns the stream URL and x402 payment requirements; GET the URL with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) header to receive the MP3 and an X-LGDA-Session token, then POST telemetry to /verify-session for a signed receipt.

tools.name: purchase_album
tools.description: Purchase a whole album ($14.99 USDC via x402 v2 or v1). One payment entitles the buyer to all 3 tracks on the album. Returns stream URLs and x402 payment requirements; pay once, then present the issued X-LGDA-Session token to /stream for each track.

tools.name: verify_session
tools.description: Submit pre/post HRV segments (RMSSD, IBI, source) for a paid session and receive an Ed25519-signed receipt. Not paywalled.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "purchase_track" references sensitive artifacts (session token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: purchase_track, verify_session · Private data: purchase_track, purchase_album · Public sink: purchase_track, verify_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: purchase_track, verify_session · Private data: purchase_track, purchase_album · Public sink: purchase_track, verify_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
